decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ -0.3% and S&P 500 -0.1% — a neutral, directionless session. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, and per past lessons we don't force buys on neutral days just to fill open slots, so we're holding all 7 positions unchanged and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup.

market_education.summary_en: Today's trading was largely directionless, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 posting only small declines. There's no single dominant catalyst evident in the data provided — this looks like a normal consolidation day rather than a reaction to major news. Low-conviction, low-volume days like this are common between larger market-moving events.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢反覆，納指及標普500指數均只是輕微下跌，未見有明顯的單一催化因素。從現有數據看，這較似是一個普通的整固日，而非對重大新聞的反應。這類低成交、方向不明的交易日在市場大幅波動之間頗為常見。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' or cautious stance means holding back from new purchases when market signals are weak or mixed, rather than deploying cash just because it's available. Discipline here — waiting for clear bullish confirmation (like a NASDAQ rally with volume) — helps avoid buying into low-conviction setups that are more likely to reverse.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）策略是指在市場訊號疲弱或不明朗時，寧願持有現金也不貿然開新倉，而不是純粹因為有現金可用就強行買入。保持紀律，等待明確的好淡訊號確認（例如納指放量上升），有助避免在低信心的市況下入市，減少之後被打回頭的機會。
